class.name: tars_recovery_behaviors/MudAssess
class.description: Measurement-only mud assessment behavior (v1): drop-in Wait replacement that records probe angle availability, wheel motor currents and stall state to recovery/mud_assessment during the recovery wait. Never commands velocity; never changes the recovery outcome.

class.name: tars_recovery_behaviors/SetHeight
class.description: SetHeight: publish target height to /drive/height_step_mm during recovery, then wait set_height.wait_duration seconds. Never inspects whether the height was actually reached. onActionCompletion is empty.
